Curious about a thorough heart health check in Riyadh?

The Cardiac Risk Assessment Package is offered at King Faisal Specialist Hospital & Research Centre in Riyadh.
It includes a one‑day outpatient visit with a cardiology consultation, resting ECG, and comprehensive bloodwork.
You receive a written summary report with a personalized preventive health plan.
A post‑results consultation, either virtual or in‑person, reviews your findings.

Read the full guide:
https://www.placidway.com/package/8699/Cardiac-Risk-Assessment-Package-in-Riyadh-Saudi-Arabia-at-KFSHRC
